project.title: Shotgun sequencing on multiple activated sludge samples
project.description: We performed massive shotgun-sequencing on activated sludge samples from four full-scale industrial and two municipal wastewater treatment plants, each sampled at two different times and with two technical replicates, to determine the functional potential of sludge metagenomes.
